items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Sonny Russo. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah right, Sonny Russo, it was a real good band... They had Don Fagerquist playing trumpet, we had Don Paladino playing lead

ctx.x: Yeah, that’s right, yeah quite a few guys. So, yeah, so Lenny was sort of a half baked clarinet player himself and Artie Shaw was his idol and so the band rehearsed and by the time Artie came in he already had a somewhat polished band plus these guys didn't take much polishing. You know we had Porky Cohen, really you know a wonderful trombone player.
Yeah right, Sonny Russo, it was a real good band, just a good all-around band. They had Don Fagerquist playing trumpet, we had Don Paladino playing lead, good trumpet player.
